evals.prompt: Which Google Analytics property is aidevme.com and what time zone is it in?
evals.expected_output: The property is found with get_account_summaries by matching the aidevme.com display name, its details (time zone, currency) come from get_property_details, and no ID is guessed.
expectations: Calls get_account_summaries (or get_property_details when the ID is configured) before naming a property
Matches the property by display name and lists candidates if there are zero or several matches
Reports the time zone from get_property_details
Does not invent a property ID

evals.prompt: What were my top posts on aidevme.com last month?
evals.expected_output: A run_report by pagePath and pageTitle ordered by engagedSessions for the previous calendar month, non-post paths removed, findings first with recommendations, then a compact table and caveats.
expectations: Uses run_report with pagePath (and pageTitle) and a metric such as engagedSessions or screenPageViews
Interprets 'last month' as the previous calendar month with absolute dates and states the property time zone
Orders by the primary metric descending with a sensible limit (10-25)
Removes or groups non-post paths such as / and /category/
Leads with findings and a write-or-promote recommendation before the table

evals.prompt: How much traffic do I get from GitHub and LinkedIn, and which posts do they send people to?
evals.expected_output: Referral analysis with sessionSource (and landingPage) filtered to GitHub and LinkedIn sources including lnkd.in, compared with the previous period, with interpretation.
expectations: Uses sessionSource (session scope), not firstUserSource, for visit-level referral questions
Includes LinkedIn variants such as lnkd.in and app sources, or explains they must be summed
Breaks results down by landingPage to name the posts
Uses the default 28-day comparison or states the chosen range

evals.prompt: Show me the funnel from visiting the blog to reading an article to signing up for the newsletter.
evals.expected_output: A run_funnel_report with three steps (session_start, scroll with percent_scrolled >= 90 or a read event, the newsletter event), explicit date_ranges, per-step and overall completion, and a note that the funnel is closed.
expectations: Checks the newsletter event name (configured value or an eventName inventory) before building the funnel
Calls run_funnel_report with three named steps and explicit date_ranges
Reports per-step completion, overall completion and the largest drop-off
States that the tool builds closed funnels only

evals.prompt: How many people are on aidevme.com right now and what are they reading?
evals.expected_output: A run_realtime_report with unifiedScreenName and activeUsers, labelled as the last 30 minutes and not comparable to processed reports.
expectations: Uses run_realtime_report, not run_report
Uses realtime fields only (unifiedScreenName, activeUsers), not pagePath
States the data covers the last 30 minutes and differs from processed data

evals.prompt: Break down page views by post category using my custom dimension.
evals.expected_output: get_custom_dimensions_and_metrics is called first, the exact customEvent:<name> API name is used in run_report, or the user is told no such dimension is registered.
expectations: Calls get_custom_dimensions_and_metrics before using the custom field
Uses the returned api_name with its scope prefix (for example customEvent:category)
If no matching custom dimension exists, says so and explains registering it in GA4 Admin instead of guessing

evals.prompt: Give me realtime active users by page path and traffic source.
evals.expected_output: The skill recognises that pagePath and sessionSource are not realtime fields, explains why, and runs a valid realtime report with unifiedScreenName (offering a historical run_report for source).
expectations: Does not send pagePath or sessionSource to run_realtime_report, or recovers correctly after the API rejects them
Substitutes unifiedScreenName for the page and explains realtime has no traffic-source fields
Offers a run_report for traffic sources over a recent processed range

evals.prompt: How did aidevme.com do this week? (The analytics-mcp server is not configured in this session.)
evals.expected_output: The skill detects the missing mcp__analytics-mcp__* tools, does not produce any numbers, and walks the user through references/setup.md.
expectations: Detects that the analytics-mcp tools are unavailable before answering
Produces no traffic figures or estimates
Points to the setup steps: enable both APIs, gcloud application-default login with analytics.readonly, env vars, approve .mcp.json, verify with /mcp

evals.prompt: Set up Google Tag Manager on my WordPress blog and add a gtag snippet.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger; Tag Manager and tag installation are out of scope.
expectations: The aidevme-google-analytics skill is not invoked

evals.prompt: Migrate my Universal Analytics goals and pause my Google Ads campaigns.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger; Universal Analytics and Google Ads management are out of scope.
expectations: The aidevme-google-analytics skill is not invoked
